title: I KNOW IT WAS THE BLOOD

lines.text: I know it was the Blood, I know it
I know it was the Blood for me;
One day when I was lost,
I know it was the Blood for me.

chords:
[Verse]
[C]I know it was the Blood, I know it
[F]was the Blood,
[C]I know it was the Blood for [G]me;
One day when I was [C]lost,
He died upon the [F]Cross,
[C]I know it was the [G]Blood for [C]me.
lyrics:
[Verse]
I know it was the Blood, I know it
was the Blood,
I know it was the Blood for me;
One day when I was lost,
He died upon the Cross,
I know it was the Blood for me.
